requirement.title: Only team administrators may start new discussions
requirement.explanation: Test did not pass for a technical reason; the requirement could not be evaluated. Join-existing-team registration does not assign the USER role (dashboard shows ADMIN for the member). On the Discussions page, Create Discussion remains visible to that joiner, so AC-1 is not met. AC-2 for the founding ADMIN was not reached in the last full candidate run that completed member setup without the USER role assertion.
requirement.source: Team Collaboration - Business Requirements Specification §4.2 Discussion governance

notes: Agent reported the behaviour as contradicting the requirement, but the failing statement is outside every acceptance-criterion step (setup or navigation), so the verdict is not accepted: the requirement is inconclusive and the test needs attention.

Agent rationale: Registers a team founder (ADMIN) and a second user via the join-existing-team registration switch, then opens /app/discussions under each persona. AC-1 asserts the Discussions page loads for a USER but the Create Discussion control is hidden; AC-2 asserts an ADMIN sees Create Discussion. Locators match observed registration, navigation, and discussions UI (roles, labels, links).
Agent did not report a passing candidate run before submitting.
